navbar.notes: navy-900 background, 64px height, 2px brand-red bottom border, --shadow-navbar; left: app icon (warehouse.png) + 'StockFlow' title; right: nav links; active link uses brand-red

page.notes: warm-oat (--surface-page) background, centered content column max-width 960px; page__header contains page title with app icon; page__title uses text-xl/text-xxl; single column on detail/form, grid on index

card.notes: white surface (--surface-card), --radius-md, --shadow-sm; contains stock table and detail panels; --space-5 or --space-6 internal padding

button.variants: btn--primary (solid brand-red #FF3621, --radius-none 0px corners, white text, hover #EB1600), btn--secondary (outlined navy border), btn--ghost (text-only, no border/bg); min tap target 44x44px

form_input.notes: persistent visible label above input (never placeholder-only), --radius-sm on input element, focus ring using --color-info (#0176D3); inline validation error shown adjacent to field naming the field; min tap target 44x44px

stock_table.notes: cool uppercase header row (navy-500, text-sm, letter-spacing); quantity/numeric cells right-aligned using --font-mono and font-variant-numeric tabular-nums; rows scannable with generous row height; lives inside a card

status_badge.notes: pill shape (--radius-pill); meaning carried by BOTH visible text label AND color, never color alone; variants: badge--in-stock (success green), badge--low (warning amber), badge--out (error red, text 'out'), badge--on-order (info blue), badge--quarantined (navy-500 grey); text uppercase text-xs

empty_state.notes: warehouse line-style icon + bold teaching heading + explanatory copy + CTA button; example: 'No stock at this location — receive an inbound shipment'; never a blank region; centered in its card or page column

toast.notes: fixed top-right, z-index above page content; success variant (green, auto-dismisses ~3s); error variant (red, persists until dismissed); no layout shift on appear/dismiss; accessible role='alert' aria-live='assertive'

scan_zone.notes: barcode scan input area; success flashes scan-zone--success (green) and stock row updates in place; failure flashes scan-zone--error (red) and triggers a persistent error toast; data-testid='scan-zone'
